cover.desc: Full color, soft night palette. Nagi stands under the indigo noren of Kotobuki-yu, backlit by warm interior light, hair clipped up, happi sleeves shoved past the elbow, forearms wet, a hose slack in one hand. Rain falls in fine silver lines. She is turned slightly toward the viewer, half-lidded eyes just beginning to widen. In the wet asphalt below, a second reflection: Nomura Itsuki in his green-trimmed school jersey, soaked, holding a convenience-store bag, standing where the reader is standing. Steam blurs the top third of the image. Warm lamp-yellow against cold blue-grey street; the only bright thing on a dead shopping street.

panels.bg: shuttered shopping street at night, tiled bathhouse facade, chimney venting steam into a black sky, one lit lamp over the entrance
panels.action: A dead street with exactly one thing still burning.

dialogue.text: There is a bathhouse on a street that is mostly closed.

chars.name: student_a
chars.pose: crowded at the noticeboard

chars.name: student_b
chars.pose: arms folded

panels.bg: classroom noticeboard, exam ranking sheet, morning light through windows
panels.action: Students crowd the posted ranking. One name sits at the top again.

dialogue.text: Does she sleep, or does she recharge?

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated, reading, sleeves down over her hands

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: hands on the desk edge

panels.bg: classroom, window seat, other desks blurred
panels.action: Aya tries again, the way she does every week.

dialogue.text: Shirakawa-san. Study group Friday. You'd carry us.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, not unkind, eyes still on the page
chars.pose: turning a page

panels.bg: abstract screentone, flat grey
panels.action: She does not look up. Behind her, someone says the nickname under their breath.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: kicking the door open, arms thrown wide

panels.bg: classroom doorway, speed lines, startled students
panels.action: The door bangs open forty minutes into first period.

dialogue.text: Present! Spiritually, I've been here since seven!

chars.name: sensei
chars.pose: attendance book raised

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: hands behind head

panels.bg: front of classroom, blackboard
panels.action: The teacher has had this conversation ninety times.

dialogue.text: Forty? That's basically early for me.

chars.name: sensei
chars.pose: swinging the attendance book

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: dodging mid-air

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: slumped over his desk

panels.bg: chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: Full comedy spike.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: sliding into his seat

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: turned around in his chair

panels.bg: classroom, warm morning light, laughing classmates
panels.action: The room settles. It is a better room when he is in it.

dialogue.text: One day she's going to actually kill you.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: broom held like a ceremonial sword

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: wiping the blackboard, back turned

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: chair backwards

panels.bg: classroom after hours, desks stacked, low afternoon light
panels.action: Cleaning duty. He performs for a room of four.

dialogue.text: Bet you can't make Shirakawa laugh.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: sweeping the broom aside

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: walking past without slowing

panels.bg: classroom aisle
panels.action: She passes him like weather passes a wall.

panels.bg: dark pocket interior, phone glow
panels.action: His phone lights up in his pocket mid-laugh.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: smile still on, eyes flat, catchlights gone
chars.pose: head lowered over the phone

panels.bg: blurred classroom, laughter behind him
panels.action: One panel where the face isn't working. Nobody is looking at him.

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: walking backwards ahead of her

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: bag strap in both hands

panels.bg: school corridor, lockers, evening sun through windows
panels.action: Aya makes a second attempt in one day.

dialogue.text: Karaoke? Thirty minutes. You can hate it.

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: arms folded

chars.name: student_b
chars.pose: leaning close

panels.bg: corridor, Nagi small and receding at the far end
panels.action: Speculation fills the space she leaves.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: one hand gripping the bag strap, knuckles split and chapped raw

panels.bg: flat grey screentone
panels.action: She tugs her blazer sleeve down over her hand without looking at it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: walking alone down the centre of the street

panels.bg: Sakuragawa shotengai at dusk, two-thirds of the shutters down, faded awnings, a vending machine humming, power lines overhead
panels.action: She walks a street where most of the lights went out years ago.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: pushing through the noren with the back of her wrist

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance, indigo noren, tiled step, sandal rack
panels.action: The uniform goes in through the door. Something else comes out the other side.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: crouched at the boiler, wrench in hand, happi sleeves to the elbow, hair clipped up

panels.bg: boiler room, pipes, pressure gauge, bare bulb
panels.action: She hits the gauge with a wrench. The needle settles.

chars.name: fusae
chars.pose: seated in the rest area, empty milk bottle in both hands

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: wiping the counter

panels.bg: bathhouse rest area, tatami bench, fish-shaped clock, massage chair
panels.action: Fusae-san has been sitting with an empty bottle for forty minutes.

dialogue.text: Your grandfather never got that gauge right either.
He hit it with a wrench.

chars.name: ban
chars.pose: dropping a crate of towels on the counter

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hands still, looking at the crate

panels.bg: front counter, bandai desk, key rack
panels.action: The tofu shop's supplier makes another mistake.

dialogue.text: That's the third wrong delivery this month.

panels.bg: the end of the counter, low warm lamp
panels.action: A pair of worn blue sandals sits beside the counter, squared up, waiting for someone.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: reaching up to kill the entrance sign

panels.bg: empty changing room, yellow baskets stacked, fish clock reading 11:34
panels.action: The last customer left eleven minutes ago. The building goes quiet.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: jaw tight, damp hair stuck to her neck
chars.pose: on hands and knees scrubbing the tile edge

panels.bg: bath hall, Mt. Fuji mural, steam, tile grid
panels.action: She scrubs the grout line she scrubs every night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes closed, head tipped back, entirely undefended
chars.pose: sitting on the bath edge, trousers rolled, feet in the water, arms slack

panels.bg: empty bath hall, heavy steam, single warm lamp, chipped Fuji mural
panels.action: The girl who keeps the warm place warm, alone in it. No dialogue.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: curled on a futon, blanket kicked off

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: at the kotatsu with homework and a thermometer

panels.bg: small apartment, single lamp, dishes drying, clock at 11:41
panels.action: The other night shift.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mild, already reaching for his jersey
chars.pose: shaking an empty cooling-patch box

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: not looking up from her homework

panels.bg: cramped kitchen, open cupboard
panels.action: The box is empty. He knew it was empty.

dialogue.text: There's none left. I already checked.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: phone in one hand, shoes half on

panels.bg: genkan, dark stairwell beyond the door
panels.action: His mother's message. He does not reply to it.

dialogue.text: Mom: Sorry. I can't leave the floor tonight.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: hands in jersey pockets, small in a wide street

panels.bg: night shopping street, every shutter down, first rain streaking the lamplight
panels.action: Rain starts halfway there.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: standing at the dark glass, hand half-raised

panels.bg: convenience store, lights off, RENOVATION — CLOSED UNTIL THE 20TH sign, his own reflection in the glass
panels.action: The one shop that is open all night is not open.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: one soundless laugh, nothing behind it
chars.pose: head tipped back into the rain, plastic bag flat on his hair

panels.bg: empty street, hard rain, streetlight halo
panels.action: He laughs at nobody. It is the loneliest sound in the chapter and it makes no noise.

panels.bg: street corner at midnight, rain, and one warm rectangle of light forty metres ahead — noren, steam venting into the downpour
panels.action: He rounds the corner and there is exactly one thing awake on the street.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: soaked, lips parted, catchlights coming back
chars.pose: rain running off his chin, looking up

panels.bg: soft bokeh of warm light, rain
panels.action: Something in his face turns back on.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: beginning to turn, eyes not yet wide
chars.pose: mid-turn over her shoulder, hose slack in one hand, hair clipped up, happi sleeves shoved past the elbow, forearms wet, towel round her neck, grandfather's sandals

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance under heavy rain, indigo noren lifting, steam pouring out of the open door, warm light flooding the wet stone
panels.action: She is rinsing the entrance stone at ten past midnight. She turns. Full page. Nothing is said by anyone.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes wide — the only time this chapter
chars.pose: frozen

panels.bg: black void with steam, screentone
panels.action: Her eyes open all the way.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: no expression at all — none of his faces are on
chars.pose: soaked, still, plastic bag hanging

panels.bg: black void with rain streaks
panels.action: For once he is not performing, and it is the first time anyone has seen it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hose lowered, standing very straight

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: three metres away in the road

panels.bg: bathhouse entrance, rain filling the space between them
panels.action: Neither of them moves for a long moment.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: >_<, arms windmilling, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: flailing, pointing at the building

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hose raised, thumb over the nozzle

panels.bg: starburst screentone, chaos lines
panels.action: Comedy release valve. She hoses his shoes without changing expression.

dialogue.text: WAIT. WAIT. YOU have a BATHHOUSE—?!

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: coiling the hose, not looking at him

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: shaking out one shoe

panels.bg: bathhouse entrance, rain, warm doorway light
panels.action: Back to real. She asks the practical question, not the interesting one.

dialogue.text: You're soaked. What are you doing out here?

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grin rebuilt, slightly crooked, eyes not matching
chars.pose: holding up the empty cooling-patch box

panels.bg: rain, blurred noren
panels.action: He picks a joke off the shelf and puts it on.

dialogue.text: Shopping. Service in this town is terrible.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: reaching up to a high goods shelf

panels.bg: bathhouse rest area interior, warm lamp, dusty goods shelf: combs, razors, old boxes, a fish clock
panels.action: She goes inside without inviting him and comes back with something.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: blowing dust off a box, holding it out

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: half a step inside the doorway

panels.bg: genkan of the bathhouse, sandal rack, rain behind him
panels.action: A box of cooling patches from stock that predates her.

panels.bg: flat screentone, warm lamp glow
panels.action: Two pairs of hands on one box: his, with a plaster on the finger; hers, knuckles split and raw. He is looking at hers.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: turned toward the door, box under his arm

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: standing by the counter, towel in both hands

panels.bg: bathhouse entrance from inside, rain framed in the doorway
panels.action: He is three steps from gone when she says it to his back.

dialogue.text: Thanks. Seriously. I'll pay you back—

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped dead, face open, eyes down
chars.pose: hand flat on the doorframe, back still turned

panels.bg: doorframe, rain out of focus behind
panels.action: Nobody has offered him anything in four years. He does not have a bit for this.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: still not turning around

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: already folding the towel

panels.bg: warm interior, steam drifting past the lamp
panels.action: He says the true thing, and she doesn't make it a big deal, which is why it is one.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: one hand lifting the curtain

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: behind the counter

panels.bg: noren, rain, warm light
panels.action: The negotiation nobody has to spell out.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: a real smile, the small one, none of his usual size
chars.pose: shrugging one shoulder

panels.bg: rain, blurred lantern light
panels.action: He answers with two words that cost him more than she knows.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes flickering wider a fraction, lips parting
chars.pose: completely still

panels.bg: flat grey screentone
panels.action: It had not occurred to her that he was hiding anything. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, small in frame
chars.pose: walking off into the rain, box under his jersey

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: standing in the lit doorway, watching

panels.bg: wide exterior of the shuttered street at night, rain, one warm doorway; through the entrance behind her, on the counter, a stiff city-office envelope pushed half under the cash tray — unopened
panels.action: The chapter closes on the envelope neither of them is looking at.
